result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.k_shell()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Extract the k-shell subgraph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L17019-L17062){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.k_shell(k) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} The k-shell contains nodes with coreness exactly equal to `k`. The coreness of a node is the highest `k` for which the node is part of the k-core. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Coreness value to extract. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : New graph containing only the k-shell nodes and their connecting edges. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#2a15b119 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph() for i in range(5): g.add_node(label=str(i)) g.add_edge("0", "1") g.add_edge("1", "2") g.add_edge("2", "3") g.add_edge("3", "4") # Get shell of nodes with coreness exactly 1 shell_1 = g.k_shell(1) # Returns the number of nodes in the 1-shell shell_1.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 5 ``` ::: :::
